evidence:lessons.summary: The record's rule is clear. Rebuild when the bone (骨) is rotten. Revise only when the bone is already excellent and the remaining faults are execution flaws (执行之瑕), and then only once (教训_D6:46 「只有骨已极好、只剩执行之瑕的，才修，且限一回」; 常令:79 改之铁律 「只改好车，不修垃圾车」). Any revision must clearly beat the original, otherwise 宁可不改 (常令:414). There is no numeric definition of 底烂. In practice it was diagnosed three ways: independent judges placed the fatal faults in the bone rather than in execution; each patch round created new fatal faults; scores did not rise over two rounds. The only numeric gate is for adopting a change at all (选剧情之律:19: 立得住均≥7, 好看≥现文+1, majority judge-win; if nothing passes, 守原). That gate pulls the other way: when the proposed rebuild is not proven better, keep the original. The record's strongest evidence: D6 patched 9 rounds (~40h, 30M+ tokens) with 立得住 stuck at 3.5–5.6 and fatal faults rising 3→4→5, every one coming from newly patched-in reasons. When it was redone as a fresh multi-seat build, it reached 好看 8.5 (vs 4.5) and was accepted about 4 hours after the sixth-trial verification run started. D3 ($9.33, 1h20m) and the rest-of-book plan W17 ($24.59, 2h20m) were also built from scratch and both accepted with 0 fatal. 'Rebuild' is not automatically better, though. In the whole-book upgrade (大升级_总案, 10-06), 12 whole-book new-bone proposals all failed the gate (立得住 3.4–5.3). The verdict was 守原+必修: keep the first-class bone, fix every bug, compress 1–379 to ~232 chapters. The text then stood at 好看4.5/立得住3.5, and 'only ~120 of 379 chapters truly gripping'. That chapter-by-chapter rewrite (W11) was never run: 0 backup files, the decision column is empty, it was retired 10-27, and its ≥95 gate was deleted today (1119) as empty. 22 compression/merge items wait for 「全书写完後之二稿」. Revising old chapters with models per chapter burned money (W58: $174.31 vs $77 estimate, ~$140 wasted, halted by the author). Fixes that were decided once at the source and then applied by script cost almost nothing (D1施.py over 95 chapters, 0 tokens; W26 70/70 items for $64). Small capped rewrites of thin chapters were cheap (W77: 3 chapters, $6.88). The stop-loss gate (工作流账.py) enforces only a time limit: overtime without a verdict turns the test suite red and blocks pushes. It allows 续 at most once and 重造 at most twice, and has no 守原 exit. It has never triggered a plot rebuild: across 129 items its record is 取71/续14/重造1 (a note-taking method)/停1. The 1.5× cost stop (费哨 --跑) is a manual tool, and 「两次不成即换法」 is printed text only.

findings.claim: Explicit rule (revise vs rebuild): revise only a 'good car' whose bone is excellent and whose remaining faults are execution flaws, and only once; anything with a bad bone is torn down and rebuilt, keeping the best parts (取其精华). Every revision must clearly beat the original, otherwise do not revise.

evidence:early_a.summary: For chapters 1–190, the record mostly points to skin problems, not broken bones. All three full-read seats (小说家, 老读者, 评委), section after section, call the bones good and blame volume, repetition, disclaimer/ledger voice and number errors. Typical verdicts: 「骨是对的，心是真的，账是乱的」 (81–90), 「骨头是全书最好的骨头之一，肉里掺了一半水」 (131–140), 「病在肉」 (161–170), 「这副骨只值三章，现用了十章」 (181–190). At book level the 10-06 master plan (大升级_总案) tested 12 whole-book "new bone" alternatives. All failed the 立得住 gate (3.4–5.3 against a threshold of 7; none won a majority), so it ruled 「骨不换，病全治，量大压」. The seats' own remedy votes for ch1–190 say the same thing: of 570 seat-votes, 61% are merge/compress/delete, 26% fix, 8% rewrite and 3% keep. Only 10 of 190 chapters (5%) got two or more rewrite votes. Part of the bloat was made by the production pipeline, not the plot: 111–150 is fifteen chapters hard-split into thirty at a word-count ceiling after 「十轮加厚」. By station: E1 柏冢 (1–41) has a first-rate opening and a real peak at 21. But 22–40 has no working spine: the 南绕 detour has no reason to exist, B3 repeats B2, there is no goal and no visible opponent, and the climax rests on 「恰好回落」. The engine (九股) is absent until a patch at 41:124. E2 楼兰 (42–60) is the one place a seat says the spine itself is sick (「病在脊梁」): the station's defining event (安/熄) never happens on the page and is written backwards (49 收 vs 50 醒). Its human aftermath, 56–60, is among the best pages in the book. E3 青溪 (61–190) has sound bones with good dramatic arcs in every section, but it runs at about 5× its planned length (planned ~40 chapters, written 212). The recurring cracks are a handful of book-wide causes, each with a single-source fix already ruled in 总案 cross-cutting ①⑨⑩ and the D1 court: the 九股 engine is off-page, 望气 is never used in the dark, thirst never appears after the water runs out on day 12, and the old man's age / the "27 years ago" backstory contradicts itself. Whether a reader keeps reading: early sections hold with abandon points at 4:45/4:99, 29:95, 32:127–33:67 and 50/55. Interest erodes from 121, and seats predict most readers close the book between 140 and 170 (141–379 rated 好看 ~3.5/10 against ~6 for 1–140). My estimate: about 11% of the 19 sections have a broken section-level spine (31–40, 41–50), or 16% if you count the 21–30 detour, which deletion rather than rebuilding cures. About 53% are sound arcs with one load-bearing crack fixable by a source beat, and about 32% are pure skin. In binary terms, about 85–90% of sections are skin-plus-fixable, and only 31–50 is a true candidate for spine rebuild.

evidence:early_b.summary: Short answer: the book-level bones of 191–379 hold up. What fails is the station-level story ("局") and the logic it rests on, and how badly depends on the stretch. 设定/大升级_总案.md:13 says 「这本书的骨是第一流的……坏在账与量」. The 剧本师 diagnosis (§五之一) puts it in one line: 「骨第一流，局没有立起来」. A test backs this up: 12 alternative new-skeleton proposals were each scored by 5 seats, and every one failed the 立得住 bar (averages 3.4–5.3 against a ≥7 gate; at most 2 of 5 seats judged a win), so 「骨不换」 was ruled (§五之二). No 10-chapter section is skin-only. Every section has bloat and repetition (the 总案 cuts 189 chapters to 113, about 40%) plus numbers that contradict each other. Where they differ is whether the section still has a working story. E3 青溪 191–272 does: a real chain of clues, a man somewhere ahead, two lines that mirror each other, and peaks at 211, 221, 232, 259 and 268–269. Its breaks are load-bearing logic: water and food, the sky appearing, the trap with no stated cause, 望气 never used, the 272 meeting as strangers, 东头 left behind. Each of these already has a source fix designed in the 总案 (横贯①–⑨) that keeps the events. E5 361–379 is in similar shape and is the best part of the band (365 is called the best chapter in the book; the judge estimates 371–379 at 70–90 and says the gap is 「在局，不在句」). From 281 to 350 the story itself is missing. Judges and readers keep saying 零揭晓、零代价、零拦阻, and that the white text never says why the four are where they are or where they are going. E4 is set one slope from 青溪 although the bible says 入蜀. 315 rests on four impossibilities. 331–350 has no spoken dialogue for 21 straight chapters and never names 玉, 鼎 or 悬赏. Readers' quit points cluster here: 301/307, 325–326, 333/336, 341–347 and 353. My estimate: about 37% of sections (7 of 19, chapters 281–350) have broken story bones and need the plot rebuilt inside the kept skeleton. About 11% (271–280, 351–360) are borderline: one key scene or one line has to be rebuilt. About 53% (191–270 and 361–379) have sound story bones with logic fractures that already have designed fixes, under heavy skin problems. On D6, the eternal pain: patching the design for 9 rounds failed (立得住 stuck at 3.5–5.6). It was finally solved on 10-08 by building a new design from scratch (three independent designs, then synthesis; 好看 8.5 against the current text's 4.5). That new design was then fitted into the existing 201–379 chapters with 72 targeted text edits (G1–G72, applied, per 二稿账:71). So the design was rebuilt; the chapters were not torn down. The lesson file also names the trap of treating already-written chapters as a wall that can't be moved (「把旧文当地基死贴」). One caveat: the reviews date from 10-06 or earlier. Some source fixes have since been applied by tool (272:1509 now reads 「她叫什么，我知道」, and the 粮房两年 line is gone from 263), but the defects that need real rewriting are still in the text (315:238 「一百零八」 is still there).

strategy:reader.headline: Do both (hybrid), but let a fixed, checkable rule decide, and start only after chapter 510 is sealed. The book-level skeleton (骨) stays frozen. Wherever a 10-chapter segment's plot (局) is broken, rebuild its design from scratch (造); never patch a design. For the prose, sort each target chapter into one of three tiers: keep the excellent ones verbatim (保), compress-revise the sound ones exactly once (压), and rebuild everything else with today's 造章 pipeline (造). Every unit gets one verification and at most one fix. If it still fails, it is rebuilt or the old text is kept. It never goes back into a critique-and-patch loop.
strategy:reader.decision_rule:
The thresholds below are fixed in advance. A script computes the tiers. The chief editor (总编辑) may move a unit up (保→压→造) but never down. No other judgment is needed.

L0 · Skeleton (骨): frozen. This covers the premise, the 9 stations, the dual-line rules (二线不通消息 / 差六), and 杀钥之誓. Swapping the skeleton was already tested: 12 of 12 alternatives failed, with 立得住 3.4–5.3 against a gate of 7 (大升级_总案.md:1497-1517). Chapters 380–510 are also built on it. Any proposal that changes the skeleton is out of scope.

L1 · Plot of each 10-target-chapter segment (局). A segment is 局断 (broken) if ANY of these holds:
(a) The record already has a spine-level verdict on its old span, such as 「病在脊梁」, 「差得不在句子，在结构」, 「零揭晓零代价零拦阻」, 「引擎熄火」, or 「没有目标、没有对手」. Known spans: old 22–50, 272–280, 281–350 (设定/大升级通读/第41-50章_评委.md:13; 31–40 / 291–300 / 331–340 评委).
(b) The baseline 大审瘦式 (the slim 4-seat audit), run on the OLD span when the segment opens, finds ≥2 chapters where readers close the book (合书), or rules 原地打转 = yes, or finds ≥2 fatal causal flaws.
(c) ≥30% of the span's old chapters drew ≥2 rewrite (重写) votes in 大升级_必修清单.md.
Otherwise the segment is 局立 (sound).
- 局断: run a build-mode plot court (剧情庭). Adopt a new design only if it passes the mechanical gate in 选剧情之律.md:19: all seats' 立得住 average ≥7, 好看 ≥ baseline + 1, and ≥3 of 5 seats judge it a win. The baseline is the 总案 plan to keep the original and fix all must-fix items (守原+必修), not the current text (总案 §五之三). If nothing passes, use that baseline plan.
- 局立: no court. The segment plan (段案) is built straight from the 总案 plan.

L2 · Tier for each target chapter. A script computes it from the 段案's beat table, where every beat is tagged 旧<ch:line>, 新, or 承<anchor-id>.
- 保 (keep) needs ALL of these:
  - It maps 1:1 to a single old chapter.
  - ≥90% of its beats are 旧 beats from that chapter, in the same order.
  - EITHER the old chapter's three seat verdicts contain no 并/压/删/重写, OR it is a protected whole chapter (211, 268, 365 「三席皆保」).
  - The baseline audit shows 0 book-closing points and 0 fatal flaws in it.
  - Action: only pre-decided 原句→新句 line swaps, applied by script (器施). No model pass.
- 压 (compress once) applies if the chapter is not 保 AND all of these hold:
  - ≥70% of its beats are 旧.
  - It merges ≤3 old chapters.
  - Its segment is 局立, or the new design kept its beats.
  - It contains no old chapter that drew ≥2 rewrite votes.
- 造 (rebuild) is everything else. In addition, target chapters 1–10 are forced to 造 unless they qualify for 保, because 100% of readers read them and the abandonment points 4:45, 29:95 and 32:127–33:67 sit there.
- Rough expected mix out of ~232 chapters: 造 80–95, 压 115–135, 保 15–25. From the record: 77 old chapters drew only 修/保 votes, 179 drew ≥2 并/删 votes, and 20 drew ≥2 重写 votes.

L3 · Acceptance for each segment, using the rigorous-era instrument (the same one as the 387/397 audits):
1. Every chapter seals with 0 fatal flaws (致命 0).
2. A 大审瘦式 audit of the NEW span finds:
   - ≤1 book-closing point per 10 chapters, and no more than the old baseline had;
   - 原地打转 = no;
   - 抄袭闸 (self-repetition) max ≤10%;
   - 收尾同式 (same-shape chapter endings) = 0.
3. A zero-token grep finds 100% of the 承重册 items (the load-bearing registry) for the span: verbatim where they are protected or zero-change, as a fact tag where they come from canon.
4. Blind A/B: the 4 audit seats read the old span and the new span, unlabelled and in random order. The new span must win ≥3 of 4.
Pass means 取 (accept). Fail goes to the stop-loss.

Who measures what:
- Scripts: tiers, registry grep, 抄袭闸, 收尾同式, cost from 费账.
- The 4 大审 seats: book-closing points, circling in place, A/B.
- 5 plot-court judges: the L1 gate.
- 工作流账.py: time limits.
strategy:reader.unit_of_work:
The unit is a segment: 10 target chapters, which matches the existing 剧情庭 / 段案 / 造章 / 大审 machinery.

- The old 1–379 becomes about 232 target chapters in roughly 24 segments.
- Segments are cut on station boundaries.
- Main-line and second-line (主暗) chapters are never merged (总案:30).
- Plot (局) is decided once per segment. The tier is decided per target chapter.
- Old chapters are input material (料), never the thing being repaired.
- Each target chapter's entry and exit state comes from one book-level map (成书总表), built once. That lets each segment be built, judged and sealed on its own.

PHASE 1: preparation at the 510 seal, about 2 days, almost all zero-token.

(1) Build a 承重册 (load-bearing registry): one machine list of chapter:line + verbatim/fact flag. It merges:
- the 护 lines (总案:308-491; about 151 items, about 2,900 lines);
- the D4 zero-change list (总案:1533) and the 11 D4 second-draft protected sentences;
- the D6 tables (96, 97, 111, 115, 116, 201, 221, 232, 235, 259, 261, 263, 265, 267, 270, 312, 331, 361);
- the 40 叫绝 beats;
- the 53 early-chapter references in 余章总案;

- the canon original scenes;
- payoffs already used by 380+ (18:27-33, 115:285-305, 295, 376:77);
- the 23 新事实 (总案:273-300) and the 22 二稿 items.

(2) Build an old→target chapter map by parsing the 总案 §一之一 table.

(3) Parse the per-chapter seat verdicts from 必修清单.

(4) Build the 成书总表 once, W17-style:
- 3 seats each build independently from a zero-token material pack: the 总案 table, the 承重册, the sealed 381–510, and the 新事实.
- The chief editor synthesises; then a zero-token prescreen, one fatal-only judge, and one fix.
- Output: entry/exit state for every target chapter, plus which plants each 381–510 payoff needs, so that seams are fixed at the source 「改到像一开始就这么写的」 (反面教材 第二例).
- Cap: $160 and 3 hours (W17 cost $24.59 and took 2h20m).

PHASE 2/3: per segment, front to back.

(5) Open the item in 工作流账 with a time limit, stop line and $ estimate. Run the baseline 大审瘦式 on the OLD span (about $13).

(6) If L1 says 局断, run the plot court in build mode, the way the D6 sixth trial and D3 were done:
- 3 designers each build the whole segment from scratch, inside the frozen skeleton and the registry. They do not edit the old outline.
- Each design is reviewed adversarially by 2 seats.
- The synthesis keeps the strongest skeleton and every old beat that reads 「哇，写得太好了」 (取其精华).
- Then a zero-token prescreen, ONE verification and ONE fix, then the mechanical gate.

(7) Build the 段案 with the tagged beat table. The script assigns the tiers.

(8) Build each chapter by tier:
- 保: script-applied line swaps only (器施).
- 压: ONE seat works on the old text, guided by the 段案 beats and the 必修 cut/fix list, carrying registry lines verbatim and landing inside the net-length (净重) band. Then the fatal-only checks (机闸 + 逻辑审 + 盲读) and at most one fix.
- 造: the full 造章 pipeline (三魂 → three writers each write the whole chapter → blind expert choice → merge that fixes only fatal flaws and big gains → fatal-only verification → seal). Old text and the registry are material, not the base. This is how a chapter is "built to full marks": every seat writes a complete chapter for 100, and no fixes come afterward.

(9) Zero-token checks: registry grep, 抄袭闸, 收尾同式, net length.

(10) Run the segment 大审瘦式 plus the blind A/B, and apply L3.

(11) Write the retrospective (复盘, 3 questions).

How revisions are kept bounded:
- Every change to text that will survive is decided once at the source (段案 or court) and written as a 原句→新句 diff or a beat list.
- Each unit gets exactly one pass and one fix.
- No seat ever reads its own output and improves it a second time.

PHASE 4: finishing.
- Renumber 380–510 by script and remap the chapter:line references in 设定 (zero token).
- Run one whole-book audit across segment joins, plus the canon check.
- The finished book is about 363 chapters.
strategy:reader.stop_loss:
S1 · No patch loops. Any unit (a segment design or a chapter) gets ONE verification and at most ONE fix.
- If it fails again, it is rebuilt from scratch by fresh seats (重造). It is not patched.
- At most 2 builds per unit. If both fail, the unit keeps its old text plus script-applied line fixes (原胜/守原). This is logged in 工作流账 as 取 with the reason 「原胜·选剧情之律:17」, because the tool refuses a 守原 verdict. The unit goes onto the second-draft deficit list.
- A 压 chapter that fails the seal after its one fix converts to 造. It never gets a second compress pass.

S2 · The D6 signature.
- If a fix introduces a fatal flaw that was not there before, stop fixing and rebuild immediately (D6 went 3→4→5 fatal flaws, every one newly patched in).
- If a unit's key metric (book-closing count, or 立得住 average) does not improve from attempt 1 to attempt 2, stop that method (常令 「两轮不见涨立停」).

S3 · Global halt. If 2 consecutive segments end in 原胜/守原, or any segment hits S1 twice, HALT the whole second draft. Before spending another dollar, compare ≥2 differently shaped methods (教训_D6 铁则1).

S4 · Pilot gate. Segment 1 (target 1–10) must pass L3 at ≤1.5× its estimate before segment 2 opens. The first 5 压 chapters calibrate the tier:
- If they average >$30 or more than 1 fails the seal, abolish the 压 tier. Re-tier those chapters to 造 if the budget allows; otherwise keep the old text with line fixes.

S5 · Cost caps, enforced by running 费哨 --跑 at every chapter seal:
- per chapter: 保 $5, 压 $30, 造 $95, which is 1.5× the $63.65 all-in figure;
- per plot court: $90, the W75 level;
- per segment: 1.5× its estimate.
Hitting a cap means rebuild or keep the old text, never continue.
- Cumulative: if spend at a segment seal exceeds 1.25× the pro-rata plan, halt and re-plan.
- Absolute ceiling for the whole second draft: $13k.

S6 · Time. Each segment has a 工作流账 time limit of 1.5× plan, about 55 hours per 10 target chapters. Overtime turns the suite red. 续 (extend) is allowed once and 重造 (rebuild) at most twice, both hard-coded at 工作流账.py:325-360.

Maximum rounds: plot-court verification ≤2 (hard-coded in 剧情庭.js), fix ≤1 per unit, builds ≤2 per unit.

strategy:pain.headline: Do both, but let one contest decide each part instead of a judgment about whether its base is rotten. After chapter 510 is sealed, cut 1–379 into about 22 units. For each unit, run exactly one plot court (剧情庭) in which fresh multi-seat rebuild designs compete against the already-paid 总案 repair plan. Rebuild only when a new design passes the mechanical gate: 立得住≥7, 好看≥plan+1, majority of seats judge it the winner. Otherwise re-write the certified plan once (compress-revise). Never patch a design, never revise a chapter twice, and anything that fails twice drops to the zero-token floor (Plan Z). Expected result: about 25–35% of target chapters rebuilt (22–50, 269/272, 273–360), about 65–75% compress-revised, about $10k, 6–9 weeks.
strategy:pain.decision_rule:
PRINCIPLE: the question "is this base rotten?" is never debated. That debate is what burned D6 (9 rounds, 立得住 stuck at 3.5–5.6, fatal faults 3→4→5, 设定/方法账.md:5; real ledger cost $729.57 against about $111 for the rebuild that worked). It is replaced by one build-off per unit, scored once, with the verdict applied by script.

STEP A, eligibility (zero-token script, before any scoring). A candidate design is eligible only if:
- every item in the unit's anchor registry is placed, and protected lines (护句 and D4 零改) are kept byte-exact;
- its exit state equals the unit's boundary contract;
- the 23 新事实 and the 横贯 fixes that touch the unit are present.
An ineligible design is dropped, not patched. (This is the D6 lesson's 全书对账表, 教训_D6:43.)

STEP B, one court (工具/席/剧情庭.js; its seats score; verification capped at 2 rounds by the hard-coded `while (轮 < 2)` at :79). The court scores three things:
- 现文: the current text;
- P: the incumbent, i.e. the 总案 plan for this unit (大升级_总案 §一 compression plus §四 必修 plus 横贯);
- R1..Rk: fresh rebuild designs.
A script applies these rules in order:
1. REBUILD if the best eligible Ri has 立得住 avg ≥7.0, AND 好看 avg ≥ 好看avg(P)+1.0, AND more than half of the seats independently judge Ri > P. This is 选剧情之律:19 tightened by 总案:1526 「须真胜本案」.
2. Else COMPRESS-REVISE if 立得住avg(P) ≥7.0. This is the "good car" certificate (常令:79 只改好车).
3. Else BEST-OF, one shot: take the candidate (P or an eligible Ri) with the highest 立得住 avg, provided it is ≥6.0 and its 好看 avg ≥ 现文+1.0 (常令:113 过门即取 logic). Execute it on its own path (Ri → rebuild, P → revise) and log its residual flaws in 二稿账. No further design rounds.
4. Else KEEP (Plan Z): apply only the already-decided 原句→新句 diffs by tool (改单.py --施单 / D1施.py style, zero tokens), and delete chapters that ≥2 seats voted 删 and that carry 0 anchors. All other prose stays untouched.

CHAPTER LEVEL inside the chosen plan (assigned by rule, not by debate):
- KEEP-verbatim (plus 器施): whole-chapter protections (211, 268) and chapters that have ≥1 保 vote, 0 甲 loopholes, and only 器施-expressible 必修 items.
- BUILD fresh: chapters with ≥2 seat 重写 votes in 大升级_必修清单: 13, 35, 40, 46, 49, 50, 70, 96, 180, 190, 199, 235, 240, 263, 272, 307, 313, 315, 330, 331, 357. Any protected lines inside them are carried byte-exact.
- MERGE/COMPRESS: every other chapter.

WHO MEASURES:
- design scores: the court seats; the threshold arithmetic: a script over the court's score table;
- anchors: a grep script against the registry;
- fatal counts: the 造章 closure review output (致命 N), parsed;
- cost: 费账.json plus 费哨 --跑, wired to run automatically after every Run;
- time: the 工作流账.py 时限.
No LLM and no human decides a verdict by discussion.

PRE-ROUTING (zero-token, reusing the $2.9k of 大升级 diagnosis already paid) sets only the court's size, not its verdict.
- FLAGGED, 3 rebuild designers: 22–41, 42–60, 261–272, 273–313, 314–330, 331–360. Evidence: 「病在脊梁」 at 41–50; 「差得不在句子，在结构」 at 31–40; 「零揭晓，零代价，零拦阻」 at 291–300 and 331–340; 315 rests on four impossibilities; 272 has the leads meet as strangers.

Base rate showing the gate is a real filter: of the segment courts 391–471, 6 adopted a new design and 3 (421, 431, 451) kept the original.
strategy:pain.unit_of_work:
A "二稿单元" (second-draft unit) is about 8–14 target chapters, cut mechanically from the 总案 compression table (设定/大升级_总案.md:35–73, 124 merge groups, 379→about 232) at station or arc boundaries. That gives about 22 units:
- U01: 1–21
- U02*: 22–41
- U03*: 42–60
- U04–U13: E3 61–260, about 11–13 targets each
- U14*: 261–272 (includes 269 and 272)
- U15–U17*: E4 273–313 (→ about 27)
- U18*: 收後 314–330 (→ about 8)
- U19–U20*: 程 331–360 (→ about 16)
- U21–U22: E5 361–379 (→ about 15)
(* = flagged.)

Each unit carries four inputs:
1. A frozen boundary contract (入态/出态): day count, place, who knows what, objects carried, wounds, water and food, open threads. It is taken from the old text at the boundary, plus the 23 新事实 and the 横贯 fixes.
2. Its slice of the anchor registry.
3. Its 必修 items (总案 §四 and 二稿账).
4. The 380–510 lines that cite it (from a grep of chapter:line references).

One unit = 1 court + 1 段案 + its chapters + 1 大审瘦式, with that 大审 also reading 2 chapters on each side of each seam, and then one atomic swap into a parallel 二稿 tree.

Because each unit's exit state is contract-identical to the old text's, any unit can be either new or old (Plan Z) and the book stays consistent. That is what makes a half-finished rewrite structurally impossible.
strategy:pain.method:
1. FREEZE (zero-token, after 510 and its 大审 are sealed). Scripts build:
- the anchor registry: 护句; D4 零改 and 二稿护句; the 叫绝之拍库's 40 beats; canon facts citing <380; 余章总案 and 段案 references; FS01/16/17;
- the unit map and the per-unit boundary contracts;
- per-unit 必修 lists;
- the reverse-reference index from 380–510 into 1–379.
The 二稿 driver is wired so that, after every Run, it automatically calls 费哨 --跑, parses 致命 counts, and runs the anchor grep. Tool work is capped at $150 and rehearsed on real data before use (丝滑).

2. BUILD-OFF per unit (the only design step; 造到满分 happens here):
- Each rebuild designer works independently toward 10/10. Designers get the bible, the contract, the anchors, the 叫绝 beats and the unit's 总案 diagnosis of what is wrong. They do NOT get the old prose. This avoids 把旧文当地基死贴 (教训_D6:16) while keeping 取其精华 through the anchors.
- The incumbent seat presents P with the old text.
- Then: adversarial review → synthesis that grafts the losers' best beats into the winner (the D6 六审 method: 好看 8.5 vs 4.5 in about 4h) → at most 2 verification rounds plus 对账预筛.
- The script applies the decision rule. The design is then FROZEN: nothing found later edits the design.

3. REBUILD path: the unit's 段案, then 造章 for each target chapter exactly as for 471+. 章料 lists the unit's anchors as must-carry, and protected lines are pasted byte-exact. The per-chapter closure is unchanged: one review, at most one fix, sealed only at 致命 0.

4. COMPRESS-REVISE path (bounded): one 合章 Run per target chapter. Inputs: the plan's spec for that chapter, the old source chapters, its 必修 items and the protected lines. Sequence: write once → one closure review → at most one fix → seal at 致命 0. There is no second fix, no re-review loop, no "polish" pass, and 「微」 edits are forbidden (as in 大审.js). Any old sentence not on the protected or 保 list may be freely cut.

5. UNIT CLOSE:
- Zero-token checks: 100% of anchors present byte-exact; target chapter count within plan ±1; exit-state fields match the contract.
- Then a 大审瘦式 over the unit and its seams. A seam fatal gets one fix; if it fails again → unit trip.
- Swap the unit atomically into 二稿/正文 (正文 itself is untouched).
- Close the 工作流账 item (取 with 所废/较旧 and a retrospective).

6. FINAL: assemble all units (new or Plan Z), renumber, and remap the 380–510 chapter:line references by script. Then run one 大审 on the 379/380 seam, and switch the canonical text in one commit.

7. The same rule applies to any future "this plot isn't good" moment, including in 380–510: one build-off, never a patch loop.
strategy:pain.stop_loss:
All limits are numeric and machine-read. The driver reds 全测 and blocks pushes on any breach, extending the existing behaviour of 工作流账.py:84-94.

PER CHAPTER:
- S1: exactly 1 write, 1 review and ≤1 fix. 致命 > 0 after the fix → the chapter FAILS.
- S2: Run cost > 1.5× its estimate (费哨 --跑, automatic) → the Run is killed and the chapter FAILS.
- S3 (the D6 signature): a fix that introduces any fatal not present in the pre-fix review → the chapter FAILS immediately.
- What happens on failure:
  - in a revise unit: the chapter is rebuilt once with 造章 from the frozen plan, starting from scratch, not from the failed draft;
  - in a rebuild unit, or on a second failure: the unit trips.

PER UNIT:
- U1: exactly 1 court, ever, with ≤2 verification rounds. Caps: $120 and 6h for a flagged court, $60 for a light one. On breach: the verdict defaults to P if 立得住(P) ≥7, else Plan Z.
- U2: unit budget = 1.5 × (court + rebuild chapters × $64 + revise chapters × $35 + $13 大审); time limit = 1.5 × (6h + 3.6h per target chapter). Exceeding either → unit trip.
- U3: 2 failed chapters in one unit → unit trip.
- U4, what a trip does:
  - A revise unit converts once to its court's best eligible rebuild design, but only if that design scored 立得住 ≥7; no new court.
  - A rebuild unit or an already-converted unit → Plan Z. Its new chapters are archived (not swapped) and the unit closes as 取 「器施-only; residual → 二稿账」.
- Hard maximum: 2 executions per unit. Never 3.

GLOBAL:
- G1, pilot gate after U01–U03:
  - actual cost per target chapter ≤1.5× estimate;
  - 100% of sealed chapters at 致命 0;
  - 100% of anchors byte-exact;
  - 0 seam fatals into old 61.
  If the gate fails: one method change is allowed (e.g. change the 合章 inputs), re-piloted on U04 only. If that fails too, all remaining units go to Plan Z and the second draft closes. That is the only 换法 in the whole programme.
- G2: at every unit close, cumulative actual ÷ cumulative estimate for the closed units > 1.5 → no new units open; every unopened unit goes to Plan Z.
- G3: 3 unit trips in total → every unopened unit goes to Plan Z.
- G4: hard caps of $12k total and 10 calendar weeks from pilot start. On either, the in-flight unit finishes or goes to Plan Z, and everything else goes to Plan Z.

GUARANTEE: Plan Z is zero-token, so every exit path closes every unit within days. The canonical book is never inconsistent and never worse than today.

Looping on a weak bone is what caused the eternal pain (D6).
strategy:structure.decision_rule:
WHO / WHAT MEASURES IT. A zero-token tally script computes signals A and B from records that are already paid for. Signal C comes from a fixed-word search; the 总编辑 confirms each hit once by pasting the reviewer's sentence into a frozen table (proposed file 设定/二稿_分类表). After that the table changes only through the conversion triggers in stop_loss, never through debate. Nobody re-scores, and there is no W11-style "five seats × three alternatives per section".

SIGNALS, per 10-chapter section (38 sections; same split as 设定/大升级通读 and 大升级_必修清单):
- A (weak): the 评委 section score (overall, or 立得住 where given) is below 70. Examples from the files: 31–40 = 53; 41–50 = 54; 281–290 = 61/53; 291–300 = 64; 311–320 = 60; 331–340 = 54.
- B (votes, from 必修清单 「逐章三席之判」): at least 25% of the section's chapters have at least one 重写 vote, OR at least 2 chapters have at least two 重写 votes.
- C (spine): the section's own review says that at least 2 of the 4 parts of the 局 are missing across the section, OR it says the main fault is in 脊梁/结构 rather than in 句/账/量/肉/皮. The 4 parts are: a goal (目标, or why they act / where they go), a reveal (揭晓), a cost (代价), and an opposing force (拦阻/对手). Examples: 31–40 「差得不在句子，在结构」; 41–50 「病在脊梁」; 291–300 「无一处揭晓、无一样不可回之代价、无一股拦主角之外力」; 341–350 「零揭晓落地，零代价，零外力」 (第341-350章_评委.md:23); 331–340 「零揭晓，零代价，零拦阻」.

This prevents a compressed island inside a station whose driving question is changing. Example: 273–290 joins the 291–350 chain. Its setting also contradicts the bible: the camp sits outside the 青溪 wall, but the bible says 入蜀 (横贯⑦).
2. REBUILD ONE SCENE if the section is not REBUILD but contains a chapter with at least two 重写 votes, and that chapter is on the 总案 list of beats that must become peaks (40, 49/50, 52, 210, 269, 272, 274/276/278, 290, 309, 313, 315, 330), or sits on a 甲-grade loophole whose fix requires a new event. Only that 1–3-chapter cluster is rebuilt, through the full 造章 pipeline.
3. COMPRESS AND REVISE if neither 1 nor 2 applies. Example: 371–379 trips C (「距95之差皆在局，不在句」), but A and B are both false (average about 82, zero 重写 votes), so it is compressed, not rebuilt.
4. KEEP AS-IS: every registered pin, in every unit, is copied byte-for-byte. A pin can change only by passing 选剧情之律 机械之门 as its own item; it is never edited inside a unit's run.

EXPECTED RESULT (confirm when the table is frozen):
- REBUILD arcs: E1 31–41 (about 7 target chapters); E2 42–55 (about 7; the 56–60 aftermath is kept); the E4 → 收後 → 程 chain 273–350 (about 46 target chapters: 273–313 to about 27, 314–330 to about 8, 331–350 to about 11).
- REBUILD ONE SCENE: 210, 269, 272 (274–278 夜回 falls inside the E4 arc).
- COMPRESS AND REVISE: 1–30 (22–29 南绕 deleted), 56–60 (almost untouched), 61–272 apart from those scenes, and 351–379 (354–360 and E5 kept almost whole).
- Total: about 63 of 232 target chapters (about 27%) rebuilt, about 169 compressed.

PASS GATE: the same gate for every path, so the quality floor is the rigorous era's level and not 总案's estimate of 7/7.5.
- Plot level, rebuilds only: 选剧情之律 机械之门 against the current arc (立得住 average ≥7, 好看 ≥ current text +1, more than half of the seats judge it better than the current text), and a target of 好看 ≥8.5. That is the norm for the segment-court plans chosen in 391–471.
- Text level, every unit, measured by 大审瘦式 (4 seats, ≤$25 per 10 chapters) plus scripts:
  - at most 1 beat where the reader closes the book per 10 target chapters, and strictly fewer such beats than the original unit;
  - causal fatal = 0;
  - not 原地打转;
  - 抄袭闸 ≤8.1%;
  - 收尾同式 = 0;
  - every pin present verbatim (diff script);
  - the canon / 天-日 / 差六 checks pass;
  - for revised units, the new-text ratio is ≤15%.
  These are the numbers rigorous-era audits already meet (大审_至第387/397章: 0 of 65 / 0 of 62 beats close the book; 致命 0–1; 抄袭闸 ≤4.7–8.1%).
strategy:structure.unit_of_work:
There are three levels, and each has a different job.

(1) DECISION UNIT: the 10-chapter section. There are 38 in 1–379. Every paid diagnosis (通读 three seats, 评委 scores, 必修清单 votes, 病册 counts) already exists per section, so classifying costs zero tokens.

(2) EXECUTION UNIT:
- A REBUILD unit is the whole station arc: the contiguous REBUILD sections of one station, merged into one 局. One court designs it, with a sub-gate for each sub-arc. It is built in segments of 10 target chapters, exactly like 380–470.
- A COMPRESS unit is one section: its old chapters go to its target count in the 大升级_章号对照 table.
- A SCENE unit is 1–3 chapters with fixed entry and exit states.

(3) PRESERVATION UNIT: the pin. A pin is a registered line, beat, object or fact. It travels inside whichever unit contains it and is never the thing being worked on.

Between neighbouring units there is a STATE CARD: who is where, who knows what, what each person carries, the day counts (天/日), wounds, water, food and cold. It is generated by script from canon事实库.json and from what 380–510 assumes. A unit may change its own interior freely, but its exit state card must match its successor's entry card.

THE BOOK'S BONE IS NOT A UNIT. The nine stations and their order, 一弦两用, 杀钥之誓, 二线不通消息 and 二线之差六 are not up for decision (大升级_总案.md 守原之义 1). Two reasons: 12 whole-book alternative bones all failed (立得住 3.4–5.3), and 131 later chapters are already built on this bone.
strategy:structure.stop_loss:
BEFORE A UNIT OPENS. Each unit is opened as a 工作流账 item (--开 already refuses an item without a time limit, a stop line, a rebuild plan and a $ estimate). Its stop line must name the conversion path below.
Caps:
- COMPRESS unit (one section): ≤8 h, $ estimate × 1.5.
- REBUILD arc: about 36 h per 10 target chapters (the 461–470 actual), court ≤2 rounds (already hard-coded).
- SCENE unit: ≤8 h.
The 1.5× cost stop must be called automatically by the unit runner, not by hand. Today 费哨.py --跑 is manual-only, and W58 overran 2.3× until the author stopped it (复盘/1021_W58).

HARD TRIGGERS (mechanical; no discussion):
T1. A revised chapter's new-text ratio goes above 15%, OR the writer reports that a new cause or event is needed. Abort the revision immediately and reclassify the unit as REBUILD. Money already spent is written off.
T2. A revised unit fails its gate once: convert to REBUILD. There is never a second revision; this is where D6 died (9 rounds, 立得住 stuck at 3.5–5.6, fatal faults rising 3→4→5).
T3. A rebuild design fails 机械之门 within its 2 court rounds: rebuild attempt #2 must use a changed method. Options: a new 料包 with more pins, a different seat mix, or widening the unit to the whole station.
T4. Rebuild attempt #2 fails, OR scores fail to rise across two consecutive rounds: stop. Close the unit as 守原, recorded as 取 with the reason (the gate has no 守原 verdict). That means the original text with compression only (≤5% new text) and decided 器施 fixes, and the remainder logged in 二稿账 as 「已尽两造」. No third attempt and no patch rounds. 工作流账 already blocks a third 重造 and a second 续.
T5. Any run goes above 1.5× its estimate: stop that run. A unit's total going above 2× its estimate: close the unit through T4.

PROGRAM LEVEL:
- P1. Pilots (see sequencing) have a combined cap of $1.2k.
  - If the REBUILD pilot fails twice (T4), the method itself is in doubt. Halt all arc rebuilds, run compress-only plus scene rebuilds, and treat the method as a separate item.
  - If the COMPRESS pilot fails its gate, or costs ≥0.75× the rebuild pilot per target chapter, flip the default: every section scoring below 70 is rebuilt; only sections at 70 or above are compressed.
  - If both pilots fail: halt the second draft. Fix only reader-visible contradictions by 器施, and hold a method retrospective before spending anything more.
- P2. Station checkpoints: if cumulative spend exceeds 1.25× the pro-rata plan, stop and re-plan before the next station opens.
- P3. Absolute program cap: $11k. Reaching it halts the program, whatever is in progress.
strategy:structure.sequencing:
1. NOW → 510 SEALED (about 1.5–2 weeks under the weekly cap; about $2.5k, about 141 h): finish the first draft (472–510) before any second-draft spend.
   Why first:
   - The finale is what fixes which early setups carry the ending. The 481–510 plan (余章总案) cites 53 early chapter:line refs, weighted to E1 and early 青溪, and every open foreshadow is planted in chapters 1–37.
   - The weekly cap leaves no capacity to run both in parallel (坑59).
   - It matches the standing 10-27 decision that compression and merging are second-draft work.
   During this phase, early chapters receive only the existing 坑29 duty: a decision a new chapter depends on is written into the old text by 器施 before that chapter is written. The Step-0 pin manifest and classification table are also built now, at zero tokens.
2. DAY AFTER 510: rescan 481–510 for new back-references; freeze the manifest and the table.
3. PILOTS (about 1 week, ≤$1.2k), run one after the other.
   - REBUILD pilot: 42–55 (E2 楼兰), to about 7 chapters. The spine is broken: 安/熄 never happens on the page. It carries D4 zero-change pins (42:17, 25; 49:5, 39, 113) and beat 04 at 53:23, and borders the kept 56–60. It tests the hardest case: a rebuild around fixed parts.
   - COMPRESS pilot: 131–140, to about 5 chapters. Reviewers call it 「骨头是全书最好的骨头之一，肉里掺了一半水」; it carries 叫绝 beats 136/138/140 and the block's top abandon point at 140:5–61.
   - Running both pilots through the same 大审瘦式 also gives the first same-instrument comparison of the two eras. Until now the comparison has only been directional (late_and_deps A8).
4. ONE 二稿剧情庭 for every remaining rebuild arc and scene, in one pass. It covers E1 31–41, 273–350 (sub-gates E4 / 收後 / 程) and scenes 210/269/272, so the spine is designed coherently across arcs. W17 designed 130 chapters' skeleton in one pass for $24.59.
5. EXECUTE STATION BY STATION, FRONT TO BACK: E1 → E2 remainder → E3 → E4 → 收後 → 程 → E5. Inside each station, units go in reading order, and each station closes with a 大审瘦式.
   Why front to back:
   - The canon anchor is the first full on-page scene, so earlier exit states constrain later ones.
   - The highest-leverage abandon points are early (4:45, 29:95, 32:127–33:67, then 140–170).
6. CLOSE: renumber once, rewrite references by script, final check on the joins.
strategy:structure.cost_time:
Unit costs come from the ledgers.
- New chapter, all-in: $63.65 (the 461–470 segment cost $636.53; platform median $54.90), about 3.62 h per chapter.
- 大审瘦式: ≤$25 per 10 chapters.
- 剧情庭: $36–45 per segment.
- Script-applied fixes: about $0.9–2.2 per item (W26 $64.04 for 70 items; W77 $6.88 for 3 chapters).

HYBRID (this plan): about 63 rebuilt target chapters × $63.65 ≈ $4.0k, plus the one 二稿 court at $0.1–0.3k, plus about 169 compressed chapters at $2.7–5.3k. The compress figure scales investigator V's estimate ($3.6–7.2k for all 232 chapters) by 169/232 ≈ 0.73. Joins and final audit add about $0.2k. Pilots are included in these figures.
- Total ≈ $7.0–9.8k, central about $8.0k.
- Time: about 225 h compress + about 230 h rebuild + about 25 h pilots and close ≈ 480 continuous hours (about 20 days). At the binding weekly cap ($1.3–1.8k of ledger-visible spend per week) that is about 5–7 weeks.
- Add first: 472–510, about $2.5k and 1.5–2 weeks.
- Whole remaining programme: about $9.5–12.3k and about 7–9 weeks of calendar time.

COMPARISON:
- R (rebuild all 232): $15.4–16.5k and 9–13 weeks; $20–23k if the current chapter length is kept. It also discards most of the $2.9k of 大升级 diagnosis already paid.
- V (revise all): $3.6–7.2k, but it leaves the 7–9 sections with broken spines under a patch regime. The record says that regime fails: D6's patch loops cost $729.57 and 2.34B tokens for zero output, against about $111 for the D6 rebuild, D3 at $9.33 and W17 at $24.59.
- Risk-adjusted, the hybrid is about half the cost of R and does not have V's failure mode.

Caveats on the estimate:
- The cost of a merged chapter has no ledger precedent. The compress pilot calibrates it before more than $1.2k is spent.
- The current non-writing share is 36% against a 30% limit; left as is, it would add 40–55%.
- The $11k programme cap stays in force.
strategy:structure.risks:
1. MISCLASSIFICATION. The reviewer seats are AI, their scales differ between sections, and they read text from before the 10-27 fixes. Mitigations:
   - C requires a quoted spine verdict plus a numeric corroborator.
   - Applied fixes are struck before tallying.
   - The pilots re-measure on today's instrument.
   - A compress unit that is really broken fails its gate once and converts (T2), so a wrong call costs at most one compress pass (about $25–50 per section).
2. A REBUILD BREAKS A LOAD-BEARING SETUP. 148 of 379 chapters carry anchors, and 9 benchmark beats plus the last-page source sit inside 273–350. Mitigations: pins are inputs to the 料包; the court's prescreen checks against pins, canon and 380–510; a diff script checks verbatim pins; the state-card contracts check the joins.
3. A REBUILT 局 STILL FAILS 立得住 ≥7. All 12 whole-book new-bone plans did (3.4–5.3). Mitigations: those plans used the abandoned one-seat-designs-then-critique method, while the three-seat build-then-synthesize method passed for D6, D3, W17 and the 391–471 segment courts (7.0–7.8 / 8.5–9.1). The scope here is a station arc, not a whole book. T3/T4 cap the attempts.
4. REVISION CREEPS INTO PATCHING. A writer starts inventing reasons, which is the D6 failure mode. Mitigations: the ≤15% new-text diff, the no-new-event rule, and T1 abort.
5. SEAMS AND VOICE DRIFT. Rebuilt arcs will read like 380–470; compressed units keep the old voice. Mitigations: style samples from neighbouring kept chapters in the 料包, plus a blind reader on every join.
6. COST UNCERTAINTY AND THE WEEKLY CAP. The merged-chapter cost is unknown, the cap stalls work, and non-writing overhead is 36%. Mitigations: pilot calibration with the flip rule (P1), station checkpoints (P2), the $11k cap (P3), and runner-enforced 1.5× stops.
7. THE STOP-LOSS TOOLS ARE PARTLY MANUAL TODAY. 工作流账.py enforces only time, and 费哨 --跑 and 「两次不成即换法」 are hand-run or printed text. If they are not wired into each unit's runner, the stop-loss exists on paper only, as it did when W58 overran.
8. DEFERRAL DEBT. Readers of the first draft keep seeing contradictions until the second draft. The existing 坑29 duty handles anything a new chapter depends on.
9. TEMPTATION TO RE-OPEN THE BONE OR TO "IMPROVE" SOUND UNITS while in there. Mitigations: the table is frozen, the bone is not a unit, and 选剧情之律 says 默认不改.
strategy:structure.why_not_others:
REVISE ALL (守原 + 必修 everywhere, as W11 planned):
- Compression cannot create a goal, reveal, cost or opposing force that is not there. Reviewers say 281–350 has 「零揭晓、零代价、零拦阻」 and 41–50 is 「病在脊梁」. Patching a weak bone is exactly what failed in D6: 9 rounds, about 40 h, $729.57, nothing produced, and fatal faults rising 3→4→5 because each patch added new reasons. 改之铁律 (常令:79) and 教训_D6:46 forbid it.
- Its ceiling is the 总案's own unverified estimate of about 7/7.5, below the bar the 380+ chapters already meet.
- W11 itself never processed a single section. Its per-section gate (five seats × three alternatives, ≥95) was a debate machine and was retired on 10-27.

REBUILD ALL:
- The bone has been tested and kept. All 12 new-bone plans failed 立得住, and every diagnostic seat calls the bone first-class (总案:13; D6 五审 「骨第一流」).
- 131 later chapters and the finale are built on early anchors (148 of 379 chapters).
- Rewriting the about 53% of sections that have sound spines and first-rate prose throws away 精华. It contradicts 取其精华 and 「把旧文当地基死贴」 equally, because neither old nor new text should be worshipped; only the result counts.
- It costs about 2× the hybrid ($15.4–23k against about $8k), takes 9–13+ weeks, discards about $2.9k of paid diagnosis (against 虹吸), and gives the most chances to break a setup the ending pays off.

UNDIFFERENTIATED "BOTH", deciding case by case as we go:
- Without a frozen mechanical rule, every unit becomes a new argument about whether it is a good car or a junk car. That endless debate and critique cycle was the eternal pain's real engine.

THE HYBRID AVOIDS ALL THREE:
- It spends the 造 effort only where the spine is broken, and spends it the way that has recorded successes (D6 六审, D3, W17).
- It gives revision exactly one bounded shot, with no invention allowed.
- It guarantees no unit ever loops: revision converts to rebuild, rebuild stops at 守原.

scores.strategy: Strategy 1 (reader lens): freeze the bone; per-segment 局断 test using a fresh baseline 大审 on the old span; per-chapter 保/压/造 tiers set by script; reader-level L3 gate; start after 510
fatal_flaws: It says it runs 造 'exactly as for 461–470', but the tool can't do that yet. 工具/席/造章.js has about 70 branches keyed to the chapter number (`const 新料 = N >= 392` at :24, `const 通 = N >= 411` at :49, 14× `N >= 398`, 13× `N >= 411`), and it finds files with 正文式 = '正文/镇冢秘术_第'+汉数(k)+'章_*.md' (:36). A target chapter numbered 1–232 would run the legacy pre-392/pre-411 paths. Under 总案 §一之五's anchor numbering, the N-1/N-2 files are retired (moved to 版本/), so the lookups also fail. 工具/跑轮.py:486-512 (章界闸) blocks any save that lowers the chapter count ('章数减了（并章）…照旧拦'). 工具/大升级_终排.py was never built. None of the 总案 §一之五.4 器之前置 exist. The plan spends $0 and 0 days on any of this.

The fallback works chapter by chapter inside a segment. S1 lets a chapter that fails twice revert to old text, but its neighbours in a 局断 segment follow the new design. One old chapter dropped among rebuilt ones breaks continuity, and segment-level contracts are what it needs instead.

It contradicts itself on who designs the plot. Step (4) fixes an entry and exit state for every target chapter in the 成书总表 before any segment court has decided 局断. Then step (6) says the court rebuilds that segment's 局 'from scratch'. Either the 成书总表 already is the plot redesign, which makes the courts hollow, or the courts overwrite it, which makes the table pointless. This isn't fatal if the 成书总表 is treated as a W17-style skeleton (the same skeleton-then-segment-court pattern that worked for 380–470), but the plan has to say so.
strengths: It re-measures with today's 4-seat 大审瘦式 on the old span when each segment opens (L1-b). That is the only design of the three that corrects for the stale 10-06 reviews, which predate D1 器施 and the G1–G72 edits. A segment can flip either way.

Its acceptance gate is about the reader, on the rigorous-era instrument. It requires ≤1 book-closing point per 10 chapters, no 原地打转, 抄袭 ≤10%, 收尾同式 0, 100% registry grep and a blind A/B ≥3/4. So the target is 380+ quality, not the 总案's unverified 7/7.5.
The tiers sit at chapter level, and a failed 压 turns into 造 for that one chapter, not the whole section. That makes misclassification cheap and doesn't cascade.

It goes front to back, which is safe to halt and puts reader leverage first: abandon points 4:45, 29:95 and 32:127–33:67 are dealt with first. It forces 造 on target 1–10, the chapters 100% of readers see.
Its cost estimate ($8–14k, cap $13k) is the most honest. It prices merged chapters at $64–85, not $64.

scores.strategy: Strategy 2 (pain lens): one scripted build-off per ~22 units, fresh rebuild designs vs the 总案 plan P; unit boundary contracts; Plan Z zero-token floor; parallel 二稿 tree
fatal_flaws: It lowers a standing gate. Decision step 3 (BEST-OF) executes a plan at 立得住 ≥6.0 and cites 常令:113. But 常令:113 (设定/00_作者常令_不停之律.md) says 「过门（≥7 且胜现文）即取…不过门即照停止线结案守原」. 7, not 6. It also breaks 改之铁律③ 「改就改到绝对完美…达不到这一步，宁可不改」 (常令:79) and 完美主义 「读者读得到之处⛔妥协」 (00_总章.md:13).

There is no reader-level gate on the executed text. A unit closes on 致命 0, byte-exact anchors, a chapter count within ±1, exit-state equality and a seam-fatal check. Nothing measures book-closing points, 原地打转, 抄袭 or 收尾同式. A compress-revised unit can therefore pass while still reading at the old 4.5/3.5 level, which fails the user's core question: does it make the early chapters as good as the rigorous era?

The Plan Z guarantee is false as stated. The boundary contracts include the 23 新事实 and the 横贯 fixes (thirst ①, E4 relocation ⑦, 望气 ⑨, 东头 夜回 ⑥). A Plan Z unit (old text plus decided 原句→新句 only) can't meet the fixes that need new events, so 'any unit can be new or old and the book stays consistent' does not hold.

The same 造章.js/跑轮.py/终排 tooling gap as Strategy 1. The parallel 二稿 tree makes it worse, because 造章.js hard-codes 正文/ in 正文式 (:36) and in its merge instruction (:301). The $150 tool cap is far too small for re-keying around 70 N-gates plus the retired-number handling that 总案 §一之五.4 requires, and the change must also be rehearsed on real data (丝滑, 00_总章.md:12).
strengths: It has the strongest loop prevention. There is one court per unit, ever. The design is frozen after the court. There are at most 2 executions per unit, and every exit path ends in a zero-token floor. This directly answers the D6 pattern ($729.57 / 2.34B tokens / 9 rounds).
Units carry frozen entry and exit contracts plus a reverse-reference index from 380–510. That is the right granularity for falling back and for protecting the 53 余章总案 early refs and FS01/16/17.
It wires the stop-loss into the driver: 费哨 --跑, 致命 parsing and the anchor grep run automatically after every Run. It is the only plan that fixes the W58-style manual-stop failure in its design.
Rebuild designers get the diagnosis and the anchors, not the old prose. That guards against 把旧文当地基死贴 (教训_D6:16).
The gate is relative within one court (P and 现文 scored by the same seats in the same run), so judge drift across eras doesn't matter.

scores.strategy: Strategy 3 (structure lens): frozen zero-token classification (signals A/B/C); rebuild only broken-局 arcs (~27%) around pins; ≤15%-new-text no-invention compress elsewhere; two small pilots
fatal_flaws: The compress path forbids what the must-change list requires. Compress allows ≤15% new text and 'no new event, cause or character knowledge'. Yet the units it covers must make true 九股 from 守灵夜 in ch6 (ch6 has 0 hits for 九股/拽劲), 72 立望气之禁 (a new rule the character knows), 140 听见水不去 and thirst across E3 (横贯①), 221–230 困之因 (横贯③, a new cause), and the 330 surface version of the 苏家 night (a new disclosure). The 横贯 rulings in 大升级_总案.md:92ff are rulings, not decided 原句→新句 text. T1 ('writer reports a new cause is needed') will therefore fire across E1 and E3. Each conversion turns a whole section into REBUILD, and that needs a court the single 二稿剧情庭 pass never covered. So the 27% rebuild share and the $7–9.8k cost are understated, and the $11k cap (P3) can halt the program partway through E3.

It misclassifies the weakest sound-bone sections. Signal C requires a quoted spine verdict, so 191–250 are filed as compress even though 评委 scored 立得住 33–38/100 there (201–210: 33, 「老毛病长成了肿瘤」; 243 「不是合上书，是扔」). The plan then holds this ≥85%-old prose to rigorous-era text gates (抄袭闸 ≤8.1%, 收尾同式 = 0, fewer book-closing points). Old text hit 20.7% 抄袭 and 4 same-shape endings per 10 chapters (大审_至第367/377章). Mass gate failure follows, and the plan's own 'a wrong call costs one compress pass, about $25–50 per section' is wrong. One section is about 7 merged chapters at $15–40 each, so $100–280.

Chapters with ≥2 rewrite votes that are not on the 总案 peak list still go through ≤15% compress: 13, 70 (「立题之章自拆其题」), 96, 180, 190, 199, 235, 240, 263. That goes against the record's own reader verdicts.
The same tooling gap as the other two (造章.js N-gating, 跑轮.py merge block, no 终排 tool). It is only partly acknowledged, for the stop-loss runner.
strengths: It has the best pilot design: two small pilots, one rebuild (42–55) and one compress (131–140), capped at $1.2k. They also give the first same-instrument comparison of the two eras, which the late_and_deps A8 finding says is missing. A flip rule (P1) is set in advance.

It runs one 二稿剧情庭 across all broken arcs (31–41, 273–350 with sub-gates per station, plus scenes 210/269/272). This keeps a coherent 局 across the E4→收後→程 chain instead of designing it 10 chapters at a time. W17 shows a design this broad works and is cheap ($24.59).

Classification is zero-token and frozen, with a quoted reviewer sentence per hit, and fixes already applied by 改单/D1施/G-edits are struck before tallying. That reuses the $2.9k already paid (虹吸) and closes the 'is it rotten?' debate that drove D6.
The 料包 includes a 全书对账 grep table for every object, person and date. This targets D6's actual fatal miss (263 粮房两年).
It states correctly that a broken arc can still carry gold. 273–350 holds 9 叫绝 beats plus 305:492 「手摸的」 (the last page), so rebuilding there means building a new 局 around pins.

critic:quality_feasibility.best: Strategy 1 (reader lens): it is the only plan that re-measures the old text on today's instrument, fails over to rebuild one chapter at a time, and accepts work only against rigorous-era, reader-level thresholds. It is the best base once the grafts below fix its fallback granularity and its tooling blind spot.
critic:quality_feasibility.grafts:
From Strategy 2:
(a) Replace S1's chapter-level 'keep old text' fallback with unit-level boundary contracts (入态/出态), plus a reverse-reference index from 380–510 into 1–379. Fallback then happens only for a whole unit whose exit state matches the contract. Write those contracts honestly: list which 新事实/横贯 items a fallback unit cannot satisfy, and give those items a bounded 造 of their own scene.
(b) Wire 费哨 --跑, 致命 parsing and the registry grep into the driver so they run after every Run. As things stand, S1's 'run 费哨 at every seal' is the manual pattern that let W58 reach 2.3×.
(c) Adopt the rule that each unit gets one court ever and its design is then frozen.
(d) Write into a parallel 二稿 tree with an atomic swap per unit, so 正文 is never left half-converted when the weekly cap hits.

From Strategy 3:
(e) Run two small pilots first, one 局断 rebuild and one 压 section, capped at about $1.2k. Use the same 大审瘦式 on both to get the first same-instrument comparison of the two eras. S1's pilot is 'segment 1 only' with no compress calibration of its own.
(f) Run one 二稿剧情庭 over each contiguous broken station chain (above all 273–350 as E4/收後/程, with sub-gates). Make that the 局 layer of the 成书总表, so the 成书总表 and the segment courts stop contradicting each other.
(g) Put a 全书对账 grep table in every 料包. Strike fixes already applied (D1施, G1–G72, 改单) before reusing the 10-06 verdicts.

critic:quality_feasibility.unresolved_risks:
1. The two eras have never been scored on the same instrument. Every claim that the 'rigorous-era level' can be reached by compressing old prose is a direction, not a measurement, until a pilot measures it.

2. The unit cost of a merged or compressed (压) chapter has no ledger precedent. Program totals ($7–14k) could move by ±40%. The 36% non-writing overhead (limit 30%) is not included.

3. AI judges may prefer new-style prose in blind A/B tests and in courts. The 10-06 per-section scores are not comparable across sections (some /10, some /100).

4. The decision to freeze the bone rests on 12 whole-book proposals made with the discredited method, where one seat designs and the others critique. In practice the bone is fixed anyway because 380–510 are built on it, but nobody has tested it with the 造 method.

5. Freezing 380–510 as canon assumes their own pre-411 stretches (380–410: 407 'on the edge of circling', 410/430/440 each have one book-closing chapter) need no second-draft work. No plan budgets that.

6. The required tool work (造章 era re-keying, retired-number handling, merge-aware save gate, 终排) is unbudgeted. It touches the live pipeline that is writing 471–510, so it has to wait for the 510 seal or be done on a separate branch with rehearsal.

7. The weekly usage cap ($1.3–1.8k per week) means any plan takes 6–10 calendar weeks after 510. A midway halt leaves a book with mixed numbering until 终排 runs.

8. Rebuilding the opening (target 1–10) around about 30 D4 zero-change sentences has never been tried in the 造章 pipeline, which normally pins only a few 承 lines. Voice seams between pinned old sentences and new prose are likely.

9. 工作流账.py can't record 守原, so every fallback is logged as 取 with a reason. The audit trail stays ambiguous unless the tool is changed.
critic:quality_feasibility.verdict: All three strategies give the answer the record supports. Don't patch, and don't scrap everything. Freeze the first-class bone (12 of 12 whole-book alternatives failed at 立得住 3.4–5.3). Rebuild from scratch only where a station's 局 is broken: about 22–50, 269/272 and 273–350. Give every other unit exactly one bounded compress pass, and start only after 510 is sealed, as 总案 §一之六 「先成後修」 and the 10-27 ruling already require. They differ in how they guard against the D6 failure, and each has a defect that would hurt in practice. Strategy 2 has the best loop control (one court per unit, ever; frozen contracts; a zero-token floor). But it lowers the adoption floor to 6.0 against 常令:113's ≥7, and it never measures whether the executed text actually reads better. Strategy 3 has the best pilots and classification. But its no-invention, ≤15%-new-text compress rule can't carry the 新事实 and 横贯 fixes the compressed units are required to land. It also files 191–250 (立得住 33–38) as sound, so mass conversions would break its $7–9.8k estimate and its $11k cap. Strategy 1 is the strongest base. It re-baselines the stale 10-06 diagnosis with today's 大审 before deciding anything, fails over to 造 one chapter at a time instead of one section at a time, and accepts work only against rigorous-era, reader-level thresholds. That is the right bar for 'as good as 380+'. Its own defects are fixable by grafting: fallback at chapter level, a 成书总表 that conflicts with its segment courts, and manual cost stops. All three share one blocker none of them priced. The current 造章.js is gated about 70 times on chapter numbers ≥392/≥411 and hard-wired to 正文/ by number. 跑轮.py's 章界闸 blocks merging chapters, and the 终排 renumbering tool from 总案 §一之五 was never built. As written, none of the plans can run 'exactly like 461–470' on target chapters 1–232 without a rehearsed tooling step first. With the grafts listed (contracts, auto-wired stops, a parallel tree, two small pilots, one whole-chain court for 273–350, a ≥7 floor, and the length-band fix), Strategy 1 is the plan to adopt.

fatal_flaws: L1(b) puts execution defects on the plot-rebuild route. It marks a segment 局断 when the baseline 大审瘦式 on the OLD span finds 2 or more fatals, but 大审.js:38 defines fatal as reader-visible contradiction, misreading or a book-closing point. The old text carries about 22 serious defects per 10 chapters (844/38), so nearly every one of the ~24 segments would trip. That means about 24 build-mode courts at $40–111 each ($1–2.7k against a $0.3–0.9k budget), and more 造 every time a design is adopted. Built designs routinely score 8.5–9.1, so adoption would be frequent. The likely end is drift toward a full rebuild that hits the $13k cap and halts with old 272–350, the worst span, still untouched.

L1(c) never fires. It needs 30% or more of a span's chapters to have 2+ 重写 votes, but the densest clusters are 46/49/50 and 307/313/315, about 3 of ~14 chapters (~21%). It is an untested threshold that only looks mechanical.

The pilot does not represent the plan. Target 1–10 is forced to 造, so the pilot does not test the build-mode court on a broken spine, and it may contain fewer than the 5 压 chapters that S4 needs for calibration. The two biggest unknowns, 压 cost and court-on-局断, are therefore not measured before money is committed.

Rebuild is forced by stale votes. Any target chapter that contains an old chapter with 2+ 重写 votes cannot be 压, but those votes date from 10-06, before D6 六审, G1–G72 and D1. The list includes protected chapters: 13 (D4 零改 13:163–215), 96 and 331 (D6 table plus a 叫绝 beat), 199 (叫绝 beat 24), and 235 and 263 (D6 tables).
strengths: The blind, randomised A/B (new span must win at least 3 of 4) is the only text-level gate in any of the three plans that enforces 常令:414 改章须明显胜原文. It also reduces the risk that the judges simply prefer the new style.
The cost estimate is the most honest of the three. It prices merged chapters at target length ($64–85, about 3,700–4,100 characters against today's median of 2,466), and its $8–14k range adds up.
The D6 signature (a fix that adds a new fatal means stop and rebuild) and 两轮不见涨立停 are written as triggers. S3's global halt requires comparing 2 or more methods, in line with 教训_D6 铁则1.
The 保/压/造 tiers are computed from a tagged beat table. 压 may carry up to 30% new beats, so the 横贯 source fixes can actually be implemented.
The 成书总表 is built once, W17-style, with a cap ($160, 3h), and gives each target chapter its entry and exit state.

fatal_flaws: The cost arithmetic is wrong. Courts $1.25–1.5k + rebuild $3.7–5.2k + revise $3.8–7.8k + remap $0.35–0.7k + prep $0.15k + 22 unit 大审 at about $0.29k (left out) = $9.5–15.6k, not the claimed $8.5–12k. The upper half exceeds its own $12k cap (G4), and the 10-week cap barely covers the 6–9 week estimate. Because work runs front to back and Phase 4 (273–360) is 'mostly rebuild', G4 would most likely trip exactly where the broken spines are, sending them to Plan Z. The programme would then fail at the job that justifies it.
Rule 3 (BEST-OF) adopts designs at 立得住 6.0. That is below the record's only numeric gate (选剧情之律:19, 7.0) and the 过门 ≥7 in 常令:113. It is the 降格 that 常令:17 forbids: 止损闸为的是换法、不为降格.

The claim that 'a half-finished rewrite is structurally impossible' is false. A Plan Z unit keeps old text without the 23 新事实. For example, ch6 still has no 九股 (verified: 0 hits), yet the neighbouring new units' contracts include them. Plan Z also deletes 删-voted chapters with no stitching, which can make the book worse than today.

The BUILD-fresh list is driven by stale 10-06 votes and covers protected material: 13 (D4 零改), 96, 235, 263 and 331 (D6 tables), and 199 and 331 (叫绝 beats). The flagged courts also cover 261–272 and 42–60, which include the best stretches (268 scored 87 and is a whole-chapter protection; 56–60).
There is no text-level 'beats the original' gate. A compress-revised unit can seal at 致命 0 and anchors byte-exact while still reading worse than the old text.
strengths: The structure is the most robust of the three. Each unit gets a frozen 入态/出态 boundary contract, a parallel 二稿 tree, atomic unit swaps, and one canonical switch at the end. Halting mid-way cannot corrupt 正文.

It is the most mechanical stop-loss. The driver automatically calls 费哨 --跑, parses 致命 counts, runs the anchor grep and turns 全测 red on breach. This fixes the gap that let W58 run to 2.3×. Tool work is capped at $150.
Each unit gets exactly one court, ever, and the design is frozen after it. This kills the D6 rot-or-not debate loop at its root.
Rebuild designers never see the old prose, which avoids 把旧文当地基死贴 (教训_D6:16). Synthesis grafts the losing designs' best beats, as in D6 六审.
The pilot (U01–U03) tests both paths on the most reader-critical stretch. Only one method change is allowed in the whole programme.

fatal_flaws: Logic bug in the pass gate: a unit must have 'strictly fewer' book-closing beats than the original. Any unit whose baseline is 0 (likely for 56–60, 78–90 and E5 371–379) can never pass, so T2 converts it to REBUILD. Read literally, the plan destroys its best stretches. The plan also never measures that baseline on old text, so the gate cannot even be computed.

The compress path forbids invention (≤15% new text, 'no new event or cause'), which conflicts with the 总案's own source fixes inside sound-spine sections. Examples: 221–230 「困之因，横贯③」, 72 望气之禁 ⑨, water ① in every E3 chapter (140 听见水不去), 238 搓绳 ⑭, 237 刘二画方 ㉑. These are rulings, not decided 原句→新句 wording. T1 would trip across E3 and convert good-bone sections to rebuild, which reverses 只改好车 and pushes cost toward a full rebuild. The P1 flip rule makes this worse: it would rebuild every section scoring below 70, which covers all of 191–250 (55–67), where the 局 is sound.

The cost is understated. It uses today's $63.65 per chapter rather than merged length (63 × $64–85 = $4.0–5.4k). One court at $0.1–0.3k for about 56 chapters across 3 stations plus scenes is not credible when D6 六审 alone cost about $111 and W75 cost $90.62. Section 大审s are left out. A realistic total is about $7.5–12.2k before any T1 conversions, so its $11k cap is reachable.

The new-text-ratio diff tool does not exist (工具/ only has 行号随移.py), and no cap is set on building it, which is the 痛二 tool-spend trap. Signal C depends on the 总编辑 confirming keyword hits, which is a judgment step, done once.
strengths: The best targeting of rebuild. It is zero-token, uses three explicit signals from already-paid records, and requires a quoted spine verdict plus a numeric corroborator. It yields about 27% rebuild, which matches the record's ~25–37% broken-局 estimate.
It strikes already-applied 改单/D1施/G fixes before tallying, and is the only plan that corrects for reviews dated before the fixes.
T1 targets the actual D6 mechanism (the patcher inventing new reasons): revision aborts the moment invention is needed. T3 forces a changed method on rebuild attempt #2, matching 工作流账.py:356 自裁换法.
Rebuilding happens around pins. It notes that 273–350 holds 9 of the 40 叫绝 beats (verified: 291, 294, 295, 306, 321, 324, 331, 338, 343) plus 305:492, the source of the last page.
It runs two pilots on the hardest rebuild case (42–55) and a representative compress case (131–140), which also produces the first same-instrument comparison of the two eras.
It uses 剧情庭.js's gate as-is: the 现文 comparison at 剧情庭.js:89, with the `while (轮 < 2)` cap at :79. No tool change is needed.

critic:pain_cost.best: Strategy 3 (structure lens), as the base. It needs its two logic bugs fixed and the grafts below.

Add S1's step 5: a baseline 大审瘦式 on each OLD span (about $13). This makes the comparison computable and re-checks the stale classification. It may only confirm or reject a C-signal 局断; execution-level fatals must never by themselves route a unit to rebuild (this avoids S1's L1(b) error).
2. Before any compress unit runs, add one 源头之裁 pass in the W26 style (decide once at the source, then apply by tool; W26 did 70 items for $64). It turns every 横贯 fix and all 23 新事实 that touch a unit into decided beat inserts or 原句→新句 diffs. 'Decided fixes' then cover them, and T1 fires only on undecided invention. Apply the 新事实 plants (for example 九股 in ch6) by 器施 first, so that every fallback floor stays consistent with 380–510. Alternatively, adopt S1's tagged-beat rule (≤30% 新 beats, all pre-decided) in place of the bare ≤15% character ratio.
3. From S2: per-unit 入态/出态 boundary contracts, a parallel 二稿 tree with atomic unit swaps and one canonical switch plus a script renumber at the end, and a driver that automatically runs 费哨 --跑 *during* each Run (not only afterwards), parses 致命 and runs the pin grep, turning 全测 red on breach. Put a hard $150 cap on all new tooling, including the new-text diff tool.
4. From S1: a blind, randomised A/B (new must beat old, at least 3 of 4 seats) at every unit close, to enforce 常令:414. Use S1's merged-length unit cost ($64–85) in the budget. Add S1's D6-signature trigger (a fix that introduces a new fatal means stop and rebuild) and S3's global halt (2 consecutive fallbacks means compare at least 2 method shapes before spending more).

7. Exempt protected chapters from vote-driven forced rebuild: 13, 96, 199, 235, 263 and 331 (D4, D6-table and 叫绝 chapters). Treat stale 10-06 重写 votes as a corroborating signal only.

critic:pain_cost.unresolved_risks:
1. All judges are AI seats. Scoring a design document against existing text or a plan is structurally biased toward the shiny new design: built designs routinely score 8.5–9.1, and 6 of 9 segment courts adopted a new design. Rebuild rates may therefore exceed every plan's estimate. The A/B and the pilots are the only guards.
2. The cost of a merged or compressed chapter has no ledger precedent ($15–45 is assumed). Once corrected, all three plans' totals reach their caps at the upper end (S1 $8.1–14.5k against $13k; S2 $9.5–15.6k against $12k; S3 about $7.5–12.2k against $11k). The weekly cap ($1.3–1.8k, roughly 20–28 chapters per week) makes the calendar time 6–10+ weeks after 510.
3. The two eras have never been scored on prose with the same instrument. The 4.5/3.5 score and every section verdict predate D6 六审, G1–G72 and D1 (10-06 versus 10-08 to 10-27), so the broken-局 map (~27–37%) is unverified until the baseline audits run.
4. The author's anti-烂尾 rule (no 守原了事; 工作流账.py:14, 327, 356) conflicts with any bounded floor. Every plan logs its fallback as 取, which games the gate's own 较旧/效 test. This governance conflict has to be settled with the author up front, not discovered mid-run.
5. A 局 rebuilt around 273–350's nine 叫绝 beats plus 305:492 risks a contrived story built around fixed parts. The 12/12 failed new-bone proposals show that rebuilding is not automatically better.
6. Renumbering and remapping 380–510's chapter:line references (53 early references in 余章总案, FS01/16/17, canon's 131 early facts) is script work that has never been tested at this scale.
7. Stop-loss enforcement is still mostly manual today: 费哨 --跑 is hand-run, and 两次不成即换法 is printed text only. Any of these plans is only as safe as the wiring that gets built.
8. Front-to-back order versus where the defects are: readers quit at 140–170, but the broken spines are concentrated in 281–350. There is a real trade-off between fixing retention early and fixing structure late.
critic:pain_cost.verdict: To the user's question: the record supports neither 'revise everything' nor 'destroy everything'. It supports keeping the book-level bone (12 of 12 new skeletons failed 立得住 3.4–5.3), building the broken 局 fresh where the spine is missing (roughly 31–55 and 273–350, plus scenes 210/269/272, about 25–30% of target chapters), and compressing/revising the sound ~70% once, with no patch loops. That is exactly the D6 lesson: 骨好只修一回、局烂即造. All three strategies reach this hybrid and all three wait for 510. The difference between them is whether their mechanics would actually hold. Under attack, each has a defect that would quietly turn it into a different strategy. S1's baseline-audit trigger mistakes execution defects for broken spines and drifts toward a full rebuild. S2's cost math is off by about $3.6k at the top, so its cap would drop the very spans it exists to fix, and it lowers the gate to 6.0. S3 has a 'strictly fewer' gate that can never be passed by its best stretches, and a no-invention rule that collides with the 总案's own 横贯 fixes. S3 is still the best base. Its classification is zero-token and evidence-quoted, it corrects for stale reviews, T1 targets the exact D6 failure mechanism (the patcher inventing new reasons), and its pilots test the hardest cases. Its bugs are local and fixable, while S1's and S2's flaws sit in their core triggers and budgets. Grafted with S2's contracts, parallel tree and wired driver, and S1's blind A/B and honest unit costs, it becomes a plan that cannot loop, cannot leave a half-swapped book, and spends 造 effort only where the bone of the 局 is actually broken. Two things still need settling before any spend: the author's ruling on whether a twice-failed unit may fall back to old text, and a re-measure of the 10-06 diagnosis on today's instrument.
